verification_report.summary: All submitted assertions passed sequential and canonical-dependency verification. The proof correctly cancels probability normalization in the smooth dual formula; obtains uniform L^{2n/(2n-1)} Gauduchon-test coefficient bounds from the unconditional p=2 density lower bound by positive-cone duality; transfers the formula to bounded roots through L^{2n}/L^2 scalar continuity; and reaches all L^n roots by monotone truncation with only the two required suprema. The endpoint coefficient identity, zero/infinity conventions, n=1 cases, metric/reference-volume invariance, L^1 upper semicontinuity and relaxation, root-space completeness, and the v_+=infinity incompleteness construction all follow under exactly the cited hypotheses. No nonexistent endpoint estimate, all-class uniqueness, zero-exponent equation assertion, or novelty claim is used. All named citations are supplied internal canonical dependencies; no external-paper citation appears in the submission.
